name: Strong Stingray 2
author: Lucaasbre
description: Dark pill yellow checkbox that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from #1e1e1e to #eccd00, scale becomes 0.98, box-shadow becomes none. Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #1e1e1e to #eccd00, scale becomes 0.98, box-shadow becomes none. On focus, box-shadow becomes none, scale becomes 0.98.
